description: List the block patterns available on the site (ready-made layouts from WordPress, the theme and plugins), with name, title, categories and description. Filter by search text or category. Set include_content to true to also get each pattern's block markup, which can be placed in a post with Update post or Edit post text.

include_content.description: Include each match's raw block markup (default false; can be large).

search.description: Case-insensitive filter on title, name, description, and keywords.

name: wp_list_block_patterns
title: List block patterns
